components.name: Operation secondary button
components.description: Existing local operation action; no framework runtime.
components.css: .ds-operation-secondary{min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--cm-color-line, #dce5e8);border-radius:6px;background:var(--cm-color-surface, #fff);color:var(--cm-color-ink, #163349);padding:9px 13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--cm-font-sans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);transition:background-color .15s ease;}.ds-operation-secondary:hover{background:var(--cm-color-selected, #e6f3f3)}.ds-operation-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cm-color-primary, #00747c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-operation-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.55}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-operation-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Operation primary button
components.description: Existing local primary action; its hover is recorded here as a local variation, not a global color token.
components.css: .ds-operation-primary{min-height:44px;border:1px solid var(--cm-color-line, #dce5e8);border-radius:6px;background:var(--cm-color-surface, #fff);color:var(--cm-color-ink, #163349);padding:9px 13px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--cm-font-sans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);transition:background-color .15s ease;background:var(--cm-color-primary, #00747c);color:#fff;border-color:transparent}.ds-operation-primary:hover{background:#194e5b}.ds-operation-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cm-color-primary, #00747c);outline-offset:3px}.ds-operation-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.55}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-operation-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Operation select
components.description: Visible associated label and native select, as used for explicit units.
components.css: .ds-operation-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font-weight:550;font-size:12px;color:var(--cm-color-ink, #163349);font-family:var(--cm-font-sans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);}.ds-operation-select{font:inherit;font-weight:400;font-size:13px;min-height:44px;width:100%;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--cm-color-line, #dce5e8);border-radius:6px;background:var(--cm-color-surface, #fff);color:var(--cm-color-ink, #163349);cursor:pointer}.ds-operation-select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cm-color-primary, #00747c);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Tetris navigation
components.description: Existing current-destination treatment and truck link.
components.html: TetrisCamiones 3D
components.css: .ds-tetris-nav{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:30px;height:74px;font-size:13px;background:var(--cm-color-surface, #fff);font-family:var(--cm-font-sans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);}.ds-tetris-nav a,.ds-tetris-nav span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--cm-color-muted, #536b78)}.ds-tetris-nav span{color:var(--cm-color-primary, #00747c);border-bottom:2px solid currentColor;font-weight:650}.ds-tetris-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--cm-color-primary, #00747c);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-tetris-nav{height:68px;gap:20px}}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-tetris-nav{font-size:12px;gap:16px}}

components.name: Comparison status
components.description: Text-bearing review proposal, using the existing local warning colors.

components.name: Passport container
components.description: Existing saved-document surface, with literal local geometry.
components.css: .ds-passport{margin-top:26px;background:var(--cm-color-surface, #fff);color:var(--cm-color-ink, #163349);border:1px solid var(--cm-color-line, #dce5e8);border-radius:10px;padding:24px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;font-family:var(--cm-font-sans, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);}.ds-passport h3{font-size:16px;margin:0}.ds-passport p{max-width:75ch;color:var(--cm-color-muted, #536b78)}.ds-passport dl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:25px;margin:20px 0 26px}.ds-passport dt{font-size:12px;color:var(--cm-color-muted, #536b78)}.ds-passport dd{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:12px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-passport{padding:18px}.ds-passport dl{flex-direction:column;gap:16px}}

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive name for the incumbent implementation, not a new visual direction or a claim of prior approval. The light CargoMesh product workspace uses restrained teal actions, dark blue text, white operational surfaces and explicit data provenance. It presents quantities, scope, uncertainty and source versions as readable product information.

This scan records the shared CargoMesh V2 tokens and the reused components visible in Tetris. It is not a redesign of the landing shell, carrier portal, or truck laboratory. The operations extension remains governed by [its direction contract](docs/meta/design-tetris-operation.md); historical [product context](docs/PRODUCT.md) does not reassign team ownership.
keyCharacteristics: Shared light product tokens and the declared Inter sans stack.
Bordered tables and forms with tabular quantities and visible source information.
Compact metrics, explicit pending states and responsive internal table scrolling.

rules.name: The Shared Palette Rule
rules.body: New light product surfaces inherit the CargoMesh V2 tokens. Do not derive a new global palette from one local status or hover override.

rules.name: The Internal Scroll Rule
rules.body: Keep wide comparison data in its own scroll region so the document remains within the viewport.

dos: Do reuse the shared light CargoMesh palette and declared interface family.
Do retain visible labels, focus treatment and 44px operation controls.
Do keep source versions, units, uncertainty, synthetic origin and human review requirements visible where the operation exposes them.
Do preserve internal table scrolling and the compact metric variant in Tetris.
donts: Don't promote a local status color, hover override or legacy shell palette into a replacement global system.
Don't represent an unavailable quantity as zero, count progress as physical occupancy, or the Passport as delivery confirmation.
Don't treat this scan as authority for a broad redesign or for changing unrelated carrier/truck surfaces.
